Ambassador Agreement and Offer Letter

ECQO Holdings, Inc. Nonstatutory Stock Option (NSO), Performance-Milestone Vesting. Draft template prepared for review by Legal Counsel. Not an offer capable of acceptance until Legal Counsel approves it and the Company authorizes it.

1. Engagement

The Company engages Ambassador to serve as a brand ambassador for the Company and its products, including its clinical-grade conversational AI platform, ECQO Safe Source, and its sports white label product, Bring It In.

2. Scope of Services

Promotional, marketing, and brand advocacy services: authentic sharing of Ambassador's own experience; endorsements and testimonials; appearances, interviews, events, activations; social media content; introductions and amplification; other services agreed in writing.

3. Performance Milestones

Equity vesting is conditioned entirely on completion of measurable performance milestones in Exhibit A. Milestones are objective and verifiable; the Company certifies completion quarterly. Time alone never vests any portion of the grant.

4. Compensation; NSO or Royalty

The Company will recommend to its Board, as elected in Exhibit A: (a) an NSO for shares equal to the bracketed percentage of fully diluted capitalization, from the ambassador equity reserve, exercise price at fair market value per Section 409A; or (b) royalty participation on revenue attributable to Ambassador's voice, likeness, or named content in the marketplace. Terms stay consistent across the ambassador program.

5. Name, Image, Voice, and Likeness

Ambassador grants a license during the Term to use name, image, likeness, voice, biography, and approved assets, subject to brand guidelines. New uses require Ambassador's reasonable prior approval. Voice marketplace participation is documented in a separate voice licensing addendum with its own consent, revenue, and deletion terms.

6. Content; Ownership

Commissioned materials are works made for hire owned by the Company. Content Ambassador creates on Ambassador's own channels remains Ambassador's, with a non-exclusive license for the Company to reshare with attribution.

7. Endorsement Compliance

Clear FTC disclosure of the material connection in every endorsement; genuine experience only; no medical or clinical outcome claims; the product is described as clinical-grade support, never as therapy or treatment. Crisis resources are never used as marketing.

8. Conduct

Either party may terminate immediately for conduct bringing the other into public disrepute. Unvested equity is forfeited; vested equity is unaffected.

9. Exclusivity (Narrow)

During the Term, Ambassador will not serve as a paid ambassador for a directly competing AI wellness or AI performance companion product. All other sponsorships, employment, team obligations, and NIL activities are unrestricted.

10 to 14. Independent Contractor; Confidentiality; Pre-Incorporation; Term; Miscellaneous

Independent contractor status; five-year confidentiality (longer for trade secrets); equity conditioned on completion of Delaware incorporation, plan adoption, Board approval, and execution of the standard option agreement; 12-month renewing term with 14 days' notice termination; entire agreement, amendments in writing.

BII Ambassador Content Pack, Onboarding Spec v1

Three-stage Content Pack. Stages 1 and 2 required for STANDARD status. Stage 3 opt-in, upgrades to PREMIUM. Total ambassador time: about 75 minutes.

Stage 1. Structured Voice Session (20 minutes, required)

One professional recording session in seven scripted segments: warm-up and natural register, neutral read, coaching register, fire (high energy), quiet corner (low and close), names and vocabulary, signature lines. Studio standard: 48kHz/24-bit WAV, producer-run. Output stored in the ambassador's content vault with consent metadata.

Stage 2. Champion Questionnaire (30 to 40 minutes, required)

Web form, save-and-resume, voice-memo answers welcome. Identity and story; selection of 3 to 5 community challenges to champion; unique insight capture for each; hard boundaries (off-limits topics, people, words); voice and style. Every insight passes clinical review before activation.

Stage 3. Expression Capture, "Mic'd Up" (opt-in, PREMIUM)

Path A licenses existing broadcast audio per rights holder. Path B is a 20 to 30 minute producer-led studio session with clean rights, the default. Premium status moves revenue share from 12 percent to 20 percent of voice-attributable gross and adds 50 percent of the premium-voice token fee when Elite members select the voice.

After onboarding (Company side)

Clone build and QA across all seven registers; persona configuration with clinical sign-off; expression layer QA; ambassador review session. Nothing ships without ambassador sign-off. Marketplace card goes live; revenue share accrues from first member selection.

Compensation figures reference the BII Revenue Waterfall and Ambassador Earnings v2 model; projections, not guarantees. Legal terms live in the Ambassador Agreement with Legal Counsel.

README

ECQO Sports — Sports League Subscription Valuation Model
Worked example: NBA. Prepared for investor discussion. Version 1.0.
Steven Ness
WHAT THIS MODEL DOES
Estimates ECQO Sports subscription revenue, an iTunes-type league revenue share, and an implied valuation contribution from a single professional sports league, starting with the NBA. The League Scaling tab repeats the method across all major leagues.
HOW TO READ IT
Blue cells are inputs you can change. Black cells are formulas. Yellow cells are key assumptions or figures that must be verified before use. Every sourced fact carries a cell comment with its source and date.
WHAT IS VERIFIED VS ASSUMED
VERIFIED (sourced, 2024-25 season): NBA team count, home games, average attendance, total attendance, league revenue, and the new media deal. Sources are in cell comments on the NBA tab.
ASSUMED (modeling choices, shown as scenarios): the share of ticket buyers who are unique people, the percent who convert to paid subscribers, ECQO blended gross margin, the league revenue-share rate, and the valuation multiple. These are planning ranges, not facts. Change them freely.
IP NOTE
The funnel-to-valuation methodology and the league revenue-share structure are ECQO modeling assets. Flag for the Attorney Intake Master Summary.
